correctness.rationale: The proof exhausts all four possible center labels. With center 3, every peripheral assignment is legal. With center 2, a blade fails exactly when it contains a zero but no blade label 2 or 3. With center 0 or 1, a blade fails exactly when it has no label 2 or 3, or has exactly one label 2, no label 3, and at least one zero. Every legal blade in the last regime contains a 2 or 3; because there are at least two blades, the center condition is then automatic. These necessary-and-sufficient cases give the displayed product formula, and direct exhaustive enumeration on six profiles through order 9 reproduces every coefficient and the unique weight-3 minimum.

value.rationale: Heterogeneous windmills are a canonical join/block family containing equal-blade windmills and friendship graphs. Prior join theory determines only scalar minima; the retained theorem gives the complete weight distribution for arbitrary blade-size multisets, an exact count of all feasible functions, and a simple structural decomposition by the center label. This is a natural all-function classification rather than a narrow parameter slice or a recomputation of the known minimum.
